DISCOVERY.name: Work Discovery Agent
DISCOVERY.description: Takes a real task/process and identifies friction, repetition, inputs, outputs, human judgement and AI opportunities.

PRIORITY.name: AI Opportunity Prioritiser
PRIORITY.description: Ranks opportunities by business value, time saved, effort, risk and readiness so teams know what to do first.

WORKFLOW.name: Workflow Architect
WORKFLOW.description: Turns a real business task into a step-by-step human + AI workflow with inputs, outputs, checkpoints and escalation.

AGENT.name: Agent Builder
AGENT.description: Designs specialised agents for repeatable work, including purpose, tools, boundaries, hand-offs and testing criteria.

COACH.name: Role AI Coach
COACH.description: Gives practical, role-specific guidance in the flow of work rather than generic AI training.

HELP.name: AI Help Desk
HELP.description: Handles day-to-day AI questions, troubleshooting and 'how do I do this?' requests.

TRAIN.name: Learning & Practice Studio
TRAIN.description: Creates workshops, practice tasks, role learning paths, playbooks and follow-up practice tied to real work.

GOV.name: Governance & Safe-Use Agent
GOV.description: Maps the proposed AI use to privacy, security, IP, responsible-AI and approval requirements.

LIBRARY.name: Approved Use-Case Library
LIBRARY.description: Stores reusable workflows, prompts, playbooks, agents, examples and lessons learned.

CHAMPIONS.name: AI Champions Hub
CHAMPIONS.description: Coordinates champions, office hours, peer sharing, blockers and adoption activity.

ADOPTION.name: Adoption Intelligence
ADOPTION.description: Shows where people are adopting AI, where they are stuck and what support or workflow changes are needed.

ROI.name: Value & ROI Engine
ROI.description: Defines baselines and measures time, quality, cost, adoption and business outcomes without inventing results.

RADAR.name: AI Tool & Capability Radar
RADAR.description: Tracks tool/model changes and identifies when new capability changes an earlier recommendation.

LICENSE.name: AI Tool & Licence Optimiser
LICENSE.description: Reviews tool usage, overlap, licence utilisation and cost versus value.

WORKFORCE.name: AI Workforce Registry
WORKFORCE.description: Tracks agents/digital workers, owners, permissions, purpose, status, cost, performance and human supervisor.

CHANGE.name: Change & Communications Agent
CHANGE.description: Builds stakeholder plans, readiness actions, communications, launch plans and feedback loops.

IMPLEMENT.name: Implementation Control Room
IMPLEMENT.description: Tracks initiatives from idea through approval, build, pilot, rollout, issues and value realisation.

EXEC.name: Executive AI Briefing Agent
EXEC.description: Turns adoption, value, risk and pipeline data into concise leadership briefings and decisions required.

VENDOR.name: Vendor & Tool Evaluation Agent
VENDOR.description: Compares candidate AI tools against requirements, risk, integration, cost and expected value.
